messages:
maya: Heads-up: on 2026-05-18 were switching Jira-GitHub sync from per-repo webhooks to the org-managed `gh-jira-app`. Maintenance window 02:00-05:00 UTC.

maya: Reason: central app gives stable webhook signing, better rate-limits, and consistent issue linking across forks. It also removes the need to manage per-repo webhook secrets.

owen: What do integrators need to change?

maya: Two things: 1) install the org app to your repo (or accept the org install invite), 2) update any custom webhook handlers that expect the old payload shape. We provide a compatibility shim for 7 days, but please plan to update.

gina: Example payload change: old `issue.key` moved to `issue.key.val` in the new payload. Quick patch attached in migration doc.

jira-bot: SCAN: 72 repos without app install detected. Owners list posted to migration doc.

owen: Canary plan?

maya: Canary order: infra/* -> internal-tools/* -> product/* -> external/* . First canary 02:30 UTC with infra/ci-config. Monitor issue create/link accuracy for 45m.

platform-oncall: Rollback knobs: org feature flag to route events to legacy webhooks for up to 2h. If substantial errors, page platform-oncall and well flip it.

gina: For teams using custom validators: well publish a side-by-side mapping table and a small Node middleware to translate old events to new shape. Link in doc.

owen: How about permission scopes? The app needs repo:issues and metadata scopes; we will not request write PR access unless repo opted in.

maya: Partners: well offer a short-lived proxy token for third-party repos that cant accept the org app (48h). Long-term they must onboard to the app.

jira-bot: POLICY: app install will be required for repos that auto-link Jira issues after the cutover; exceptions require a ticket.

owen: Ill kick off the owners invite sweep and ping teams.

maya: Migration checklist: 1) accept install invite, 2) run compatibility test script, 3) update any payload parsers, 4) mark repo migrated in the spreadsheet. Doc & PR templates in #devex shortly.

gina: Thx  testing the shim now, will report any mismatches here.

maya: Thanks team. Tag @maya or @owen if you need help during the window. :thumbsup:
